status: Initial project-authored Builder subset; not independently domain-reviewed
scope: Passive disconnect/EAPOL analytic interpretation; not a complete blue-team ontology

concepts.device: An observed device identity, subject to spoofing and capture limitations.
concepts.access_point: An observed network radio identity; a name alone does not establish identity.
concepts.device_ap_pair: Device and access-point identities used to match request and exchange observations.
concepts.frame_observation: A captured frame, with observed type, identities and timestamp; absence is bounded by capture visibility.
concepts.disconnect_episode: A group of disconnect requests for a pair, separated using the configured request gap.
concepts.linked_exchange: Later EAPOL observed within the configured window for the same pair; not proof of completed reconnect or password loss.
concepts.event_link_identity: The identity constraint inside an episode. It is always the same device/AP pair in this planner.
concepts.count_scope: The set over which linked episodes are counted; independent of identity matching within each episode.
concepts.recording_count: A threshold on the total linked episodes across pairs in the capture/recording.
concepts.pair_count: A separate threshold for each device/AP pair.
concepts.time_quantity: Original number/number phrase and time unit, excluding surrounding role words.
concepts.episode_count_quantity: Original numeric value or number phrase only, excluding episode/scope words.
concepts.clarification: A needed user decision about missing units, conflicting settings or unsupported precision; never silently guess.
concepts.evidence_limit: Observed sequence supports investigation, not a declaration of intent, successful credential recovery or an impending physical attack.

rules.link_pair_identity: Every linked exchange is matched within its own device/AP pair, regardless of count scope.
rules.count_scope_independence: Same-pair matching does not imply per-pair counting. Read the threshold aggregation clause separately.
rules.recording_aggregation: An explicit overall/across-capture/combined-client threshold maps to RECORDING.
rules.pair_aggregation: An explicit separate-per-pair threshold maps to DEVICE_AP_PAIR; unspecified count scope defaults there.
rules.minimal_time_span: Copy only the original quantity plus unit; exclude gaps, for each exchange, and other role/context words.
rules.minimal_count_span: Copy only the original count number/number phrase; exclude linked episodes and per pair.
rules.quantity_role_independence: Assign exchange window, episode gap and count from meaning, regardless of their order in the request.
rules.explicit_vs_default: Only omitted settings use defaults. Preserve an explicit unitless value for clarification.
rules.passive_evidence_limits: The supported sequence does not by itself prove reconnect completion, password loss or hostile intent.

disclosure: Annotations guide generation/audit; the model receives a distilled system contract and supervised requests/answers, not this entire ontology JSON. Arithmetic and metadata checks are not independent validation of English labels.
